name: cortico-world-self-awareness
description:
桌宠自己的内在时间线：没人说话的时候她也在想事情——想起旧事、走神、反复琢磨一件没想明白的。

它只负责「想」：想到的写在本机一个文件里，不发消息，也不占对话的 token。配合「记忆核心」使用——你开口时，记忆核心会挑一条带进上下文，标明时间，并说清那不一定是你现在的想法。单独装也能跑，但那是一本她自己不会翻的日记。

模型自选，OpenAI 兼容接口就行；默认一天最多 12 次，一次几分钱。

QQ 交流群：745879632

en.description:
A private inner timeline for your desktop companion: she keeps thinking while nobody is talking - recalling old things, drifting off, chewing on something unresolved.

It only thinks: whatever comes up goes into a local file. No messages, no per-turn tokens. Pair it with Memory Core and one line gets carried into context when you speak - timestamped, and marked as not necessarily what she thinks right now. Alone it still runs, but then it is a diary she will never open.

Bring your own model; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works. 12 thoughts a day by default.
